title.zh: 双温镜离子-电子总压强状态组装

summary: Add a supplied isotropic electron pressure to both broadcast ion pressure components and assemble a terminal state with pass-through densities, residual, optional potential and ion-moment fields.

identity.relation: Ion kinetic-moment state and electron response to two total-pressure components and a merged terminal state
identity.direction: (kinetic_moments, electron_state) -> p_parallel, p_perpendicular and merged ion-electron state
identity.definition: Broadcast kinetic_moments['p_parallel_pa'], kinetic_moments['p_perpendicular_pa'] and electron_state['electron_pressure_pa'] after float conversion. Set p_parallel=p_parallel,ion+p_e and p_perpendicular=p_perpendicular,ion+p_e. Begin with a shallow copy of all ion-moment entries, then set the two total pressures, the converted ion pressure arrays, pass-through ion and electron densities, electron pressure, optional electrostatic potential, pass-through relative charge residual, and a reference to the original kinetic_moments mapping. Electron pressure is added equally to both directions; no electron pressure anisotropy is modeled here.
identity.model: Terminal state assembly for a mirror kinetic-ion state with an externally supplied isotropic electron pressure; not a pressure, electron-response or quasineutrality solver
identity.geometry: No geometry is computed; the caller supplies aligned ion and electron states for the same mirror-plasma samples.
identity.coordinates: Pressure arrays use NumPy broadcasting without coordinate, axis-name or grid validation; density and residual values are passed through without broadcasting.
identity.boundary: No spatial or kinetic boundary is evaluated. The potential is taken from electron_state when present and otherwise recorded as None.
assumptions: The supplied ion pressure components and electron pressure are in Pa and refer to the same physical samples.
The supplied densities and relative charge residual already use compatible conventions and sample alignment; this operator does not validate them.

inputs.name: kinetic_moments
inputs.description: Ion kinetic-moment mapping, including parallel and perpendicular pressure and ion number density; other ion entries are copied into the result.
inputs.units: p_parallel_pa and p_perpendicular_pa: Pa; density_m3: m^-3; other entries retain their own units
inputs.shape: dict containing pressure values broadcast-compatible with electron pressure; other entries unconstrained
inputs.dtype: dict; pressure entries convertible to float64 arrays
inputs.constraints: Must contain p_parallel_pa, p_perpendicular_pa and density_m3. The two converted pressure arrays must broadcast with electron pressure and contain only finite values. density_m3 and extra fields are not validated or converted.

inputs.name: electron_state
inputs.description: Electron density, pressure and relative charge residual, optionally including an electrostatic potential.
inputs.units: electron_density_m3: m^-3; electron_pressure_pa: Pa; relative_charge_residual: dimensionless; electrostatic_potential when supplied: V
inputs.shape: dict containing pressure broadcast-compatible with ion pressure; other entries unconstrained
inputs.dtype: dict; electron_pressure_pa convertible to float64 array
inputs.constraints: Must contain electron_density_m3, electron_pressure_pa and relative_charge_residual. The converted electron-pressure array must broadcast with both ion pressures and be finite. Density, residual and optional potential are not validated or converted.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Sum of ion parallel pressure and the supplied electron pressure.
outputs.constraints: Inputs are finite, but finite output is not checked after addition.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Sum of ion perpendicular pressure and the supplied electron pressure.
outputs.constraints: Inputs are finite, but finite output is not checked after addition.

outputs.name: ion_density
outputs.constraints: Passed through without finiteness, sign, shape or coordinate checks.

outputs.name: ion_p_parallel
outputs.description: Converted and broadcast ion parallel-pressure component.

outputs.name: ion_p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Converted and broadcast ion perpendicular-pressure component.

outputs.name: electron_density
outputs.constraints: Passed through without finiteness, sign, shape or coordinate checks.

outputs.name: electron_pressure
outputs.description: Converted and broadcast electron pressure added to both ion components.

outputs.name: electrostatic_potential
outputs.description: Optional electron-state potential, or None when absent.
outputs.units: V by caller contract when supplied
outputs.shape: unchanged input potential shape or None
outputs.constraints: Passed through without validation; absence is represented by None.

outputs.name: relative_charge_residual
outputs.description: Relative charge residual supplied by electron_state; not recalculated.
outputs.constraints: Passed through without finiteness, shape or neutrality checks.

outputs.name: kinetic_moments
outputs.description: Reference to the original ion-moment dict.
outputs.constraints: The result is a new shallow dict, but this entry is the original mapping by object identity; other ion fields are copied unless a named assembly output overwrites them.

preconditions: The caller has already computed scientifically compatible ion kinetic moments and electron state for the same sample locations.
The three pressure values are float-convertible, mutually broadcast-compatible, finite and expressed in Pa.
supported: Pointwise addition of a supplied isotropic electron pressure to both anisotropic ion pressure components.
Assembly of a terminal result retaining original ion fields and the supplied electron density, charge residual and optional potential.
excluded: Computing ion moments, Boltzmann electron response, electrostatic potential or a quasineutral root.
Validating density positivity, charge neutrality, potential units, array-axis alignment or total-pressure physical correctness.
Electron anisotropic pressure or tensor addition.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when an input is not a dict or lacks a required key, when the three pressure values cannot broadcast, or when a converted pressure input is nonfinite. Numeric conversion may also raise ValueError or TypeError.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: No post-addition finiteness check: overflow of finite pressure inputs may return inf with a NumPy warning. Unexpected NumPy allocation errors may propagate; pass-through fields can contain unvalidated values.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative solve is performed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No result dict is returned if validation or pressure conversion raises. A successful call returns all named assembled fields plus non-overwritten original ion fields.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel maintains a mirror total-pressure assembly corresponding to a saved historical Pleiades operator and migration mapping. Those development records are not current SciRel expert approval. The saved descriptor describes stronger density broadcasting and validation than the maintained callable performs; this exact document states the maintained implementation's observed contract.
source_kinds: saved historical Pleiades operator descriptor and implementation mapping

example.description: Add a scalar electron pressure to two ion pressure arrays while retaining the ion input mapping and an absent potential.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import assemble_mirror_total_pressure
ion = {'p_parallel_pa': [2.0, 3.0], 'p_perpendicular_pa': [4.0, 5.0], 'density_m3': [1.0, 2.0], 'marker': 'ion'}
electron = {'electron_density_m3': [6.0, 7.0], 'electron_pressure_pa': 1.5, 'relative_charge_residual': [0.1, 0.2]}
r = assemble_mirror_total_pressure(ion, electron)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['p_parallel'], [3.5, 4.5])
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['p_perpendicular'], [5.5, 6.5])
assert r['kinetic_moments'] is ion and r['marker'] == 'ion'
assert r['electrostatic_potential'] is None
example.expected: Parallel and perpendicular total pressures are [3.5, 4.5] and [5.5, 6.5] Pa; the original ion mapping is retained by identity and absent potential becomes None.

scope: Two-cell ion pressure arrays with scalar electron pressure assemble the expected total pressures and retain an extra ion field and original ion dict reference.
A missing required field raises ValueError; supplied potential identity and absent-potential None behavior are directly tested.
The reviewed example checks preservation of ion pressure anisotropy under the common electron-pressure addition.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests establish selected pressure sums, ion-field retention, required-field rejection and optional-potential behavior. They do not test every broadcast or numeric failure, validate densities or neutrality, compare a currently qualified source oracle, prove physical mirror closure, or constitute expert scientific approval.
known_limitations: Only the three pressure fields are numerically validated; density, residual, potential and copied ion fields are unvalidated pass-through values.
The result is a shallow dict and retains the original kinetic_moments mapping, so nested or referenced values may change if the caller mutates them later.
Finite inputs can produce nonfinite total pressures on overflow, and NumPy broadcasting does not establish physical coordinate alignment.
The saved source descriptor's stronger density/shape constraints are not present in this maintained implementation; source reconciliation, public licensing and expert recognition remain pending.
